oboecraft.answer_menu.title: Answer menu
oboecraft.progress.broken: Your Oboecraft progress file couldn't be read, so you start with empty progress. The broken file was kept as %s.
oboecraft.progress.too_new: Your Oboecraft progress was saved by a newer version of Oboecraft. Update Oboecraft to play here.
oboecraft.progress.unreadable: Oboecraft couldn't read your progress file. Ask the server owner to check the server log.
oboecraft.protocol.mismatch: This server needs the Oboecraft mod, with network protocol version %s. Install the same version of Oboecraft as the server.
